sections.section_title: LTDC line interrupt position configuration register 2 (LTDC_LIPCR2)
sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.19 "LTDC line interrupt position configuration register 2 (LTDC_LIPCR2)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2131.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x070
Reset value: 0x00000000
This register defines the line interrupt position. The line value to be programmed depends
on timing parameters (see Figure448).
Bits 31:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 LIPOS[11:0]: Line interrupt position

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
